task: Draft a payment confirmation page heading, one-line order summary, delivery estimate, and a next-step instruction for a fictional bookseller. Do not invent a specific delivery date, shipping cost, or claim that the tracking link appears on this page rather than in the confirmation email.

facts.text: The order number is displayed using the placeholder format ORDER-NNNN.
The estimated delivery window is 3 to 5 business days.
A confirmation email is sent to the address supplied during checkout.
The user can track delivery using a link provided in the confirmation email, not on this page.

forbidden_additions: A claim that the tracking link is on this confirmation page.
A sign-in prompt or promotional upsell.
preserve: ORDER-NNNN placeholder for the order number.
Confirmation email with tracking link as the next step.
